subject: Information Theory
title: MaxEnt in Language Modeling
description: Learn MaxEnt in Language Modeling in one minute.

hook.text: Early spell checkers guessed the next word from frequency alone. Maximum entropy models did something smarter.

buildup.text: MaxEnt models combine multiple features—word frequency, grammar rules, context—into one unified prediction.

discovery.text: The model finds the distribution over next words that fits all features while being maximally uncertain otherwise.

twist.text: Before deep learning dominated, MaxEnt models powered machine translation, tagging, and text classification.

climax.text: Even neural language models implicitly use entropy. Cross-entropy loss is the training objective for GPT and friends.

punchline.text: Predict with features. Stay humble about the rest.

quiz.question: How does a MaxEnt language model make predictions?
options: Fitting features while maximizing uncertainty for unknowns
